stage: existing six-SUT development, no blind significance claim
prior: historical event probability versus fixed neutral p=0.5; same six-source conditional safe proxy means
covariance: same normalized learned correlation and source response modes; marginal mean/variance uniquely calibrated to selected event prior and unchanged positive-report mean
noise: original locked noise-to-total-variance ratio, scaled by the margin report variance
observation: latent reported margin Z+noise; safe case reports 1-R, collision constrains it <=0 without a numeric negative value
semantic_scope: constructed latent observation model; raw Risk is not a censored collision threshold and proxy is not a physical distance
history_control: exact previous censored_margin_response model; same feedback, pairing and protection
neutral_choice: p=0.5 fixed a priori, no target-dependent threshold or prior search; historical safe-proxy scale and correlation retained
inference: GPU float64 Gaussian assumed-density filtering; numerical values and Gaussian inequality moments
selection: same functional regime, strict predictive collision-probability advantage, paired reference schedule
protection: same actual paid-reference replay and L_t<=1+F_actual(t)/sqrt(200)
selector_payload: coordinates, history-only priors and seed; no SUT identity/parameters/future labels
promotion: both Area and Recall improve against frozen reference and historical-prior mixed model
